title.en: May Your Sleep Be Good, May Your Day Be Good
title.ur: Aap ki neend achi ho, aap ka din achha ho

intro.en: A reading text about sleep: why every living thing needs it, what happens to the body, the best hours to sleep, and tips for deep sleep. Read it sentence by sentence.
intro.ur: Neend ke baare mein ek parhne ka matn: har jandaar ko neend kyun chahiye, jism par kya asar hota hai, sone ka behtareen waqt aur gehri neend ke mashwaray. Aaram se jumla ba jumla parhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنِ النَّوْمِ: لِماذا يَحْتاجُ إِلَيْهِ كُلُّ كائِنٍ حَيٍّ، وَماذا يَحْدُثُ لِلْجِسْمِ، وَأَفْضَلُ ساعاتِ النَّوْمِ، وَنَصائِحُ لِنَوْمٍ عَميقٍ. اِقْرَأْ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً.

dialogue.ar: لا يَسْتَغْني كائِنٌ حَيٌّ عَنِ النَّوْمِ، فَهُوَ ضَرورَةٌ مِنْ ضَرورَاتِ الحَياةِ.
dialogue.tr: lā yastaghnī kāʾinun ḥayyun ʿani n-nawm, fahuwa ḍarūratun min ḍarūrāti l-ḥaīāti.
dialogue.en: No living being can do without sleep; it is one of the necessities of life.
dialogue.ur: Koi bhi zindah makhluq neend ke baghair nahin reh sakti, yeh zindagi ki zarooriyat mein se hai.

dialogue.ar: تَلْتَفُّ القِطَطُ حَوْلَ نَفْسِها قَريباً مِنَ المَدْفَأَةِ، وَتَدُسُّ الطُّيورُ رُؤوسَها تَحْتَ أَجْنِحَتِها عِنْدَ المَساءِ.
dialogue.tr: taltaffu l-qiṭaṭu ḥawla nafsihā qarīban mina l-madfaʾati, watadussu ṭ-ṭīūru ruʾūsahā taḥta ajniḥatihā ʿinda l-masāʾ.
dialogue.en: Cats curl up around themselves near the heater, and birds tuck their heads under their wings in the evening.
dialogue.ur: Billiyan angeethi ke qareeb sikud kar so jati hain aur parinde shaam ko apne sar paron ke neeche chhupa lete hain.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا الإِنْسانُ فَيَحْتاجُ إِلَيْهِ حاجَةً شَديدَةً، وَلا يَسْتَطيعُ العَيْشَ بِغَيْرِهِ.
dialogue.tr: ammā l-ʾinsānu fayaḥtāju ilayhi ḥājatan shadīdatan, walā yastaṭīʿu l-ʿaysha bighayrih.
dialogue.en: As for the human being, he needs it very much and cannot live without it.
dialogue.ur: Rahi baat insan ki, to use neend ki sakht zaroorat hai aur woh iske baghair zindah nahin reh sakta.

dialogue.ar: لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ.
dialogue.tr: lā taʾkhudhuhu sinatun walā nawmun.
dialogue.en: Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him.
dialogue.ur: Na use ghunoodgi pakarti hai na neend.

dialogue.ar: فَاللهُ سُبْحانَهُ مُنَزَّهٌ عَنِ النَّوْمِ، أَمّا المَخْلوقاتُ فَتَحْتاجُ إِلَيْهِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-l-lhu subḥānahu munazzahun ʿani n-nawm, ammā l-makhlūqātu fataḥtāju ilayh.
dialogue.en: Allah, glorified is He, is far above sleep, while created beings need it.
dialogue.ur: Allah paak is se bartar hai, jabke makhluqat ko neend ki zaroorat hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَحِرْمانُ الإِنْسانِ مِنَ النَّوْمِ لَيالِيَ مُتَتابِعَةً يَجْلِبُ أَخْطاراً عَلى صِحَّتِهِ وَعَقْلِهِ.
dialogue.tr: waḥirmānu l-ʾinsāni mina n-nawmi laīāliya mutatābiʿatan yajlibu akhṭāran ʿalā ṣiḥḥatihi waʿaqlih.
dialogue.en: Depriving a person of sleep for successive nights brings dangers to his health and mind.
dialogue.ur: Kai raatein musalsal neend se mehroom rehna insan ki sehat aur aqal ke liye khatray laata hai.

dialogue.ar: فَالسّائِقُ الَّذي يَسْهَرُ طَويلاً قَدْ يَغْلِبُهُ النُّعاسُ عَلى الطَّريقِ فَيَقَعُ الحادِثُ.
dialogue.tr: fa-s-sāʾiqu alladhī yasharu ṭaūīlan qad yaghlibuhu n-nuʿāsu ʿalā ṭ-ṭarīqi fayaqaʿu l-ḥādith.
dialogue.en: A driver who stays up late may be overcome by drowsiness on the road, and an accident happens.
dialogue.ur: Jo driver der tak jaagta hai us par sadak par ounghh ghalib aa sakti hai aur hadsa ho jata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَشْكو كَثيرٌ مِنَ العامِلينَ مِنَ التَّعَبِ وَالتَّوَتُّرِ، وَيَحْلُمونَ بِنَوْمٍ مُريحٍ يُعيدُ إِلَيْهِمْ نَشاطَهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: wayashkū kathīrun mina l-ʿāmilīna mina t-taʿabi wa-t-tawattur, wayaḥlumūna binawmin murīḥin yuʿīdu ilayhim nashāṭahum.
dialogue.en: Many workers complain of tiredness and tension and dream of a restful sleep that brings back their energy.
dialogue.ur: Bohat se mulazim thakan aur zehni dabao ki shikayat karte hain aur aise aaram deh neend ka khwab dekhte hain jo un ka josh lauta de.

dialogue.ar: فَالنَّوْمُ فُرْصَةٌ يَسْتَعيدُ فيها الجِسْمُ قُوَّتَهُ.
dialogue.tr: fa-n-nawmu furṣatun yastaʿīdu fīhā l-jismu quwwatah.
dialogue.en: Sleep is a chance in which the body regains its strength.
dialogue.ur: Neend ek moqa hai jis mein jism apni taaqat wapas pata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَحينَ يَغْفو الإِنْسانُ تَهْدَأُ عَضَلاتُهُ، وَتَصيرُ دَقّاتُ قَلْبِهِ بَطيئَةً هادِئَةً.
dialogue.tr: waḥīna yaghfū l-ʾinsānu tahdaʾu ʿaḍalātuh, wataṣīru daqqātu qalbihi baṭīʾatan hādiʾatan.
dialogue.en: When a person dozes off his muscles calm down, and his heartbeats become slow and gentle.
dialogue.ur: Jab insan so jata hai to us ke pathe dheelay par jate hain aur dil ki dhadkanein aahista aur pursukoon ho jati hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَسْتَريحُ الجِهازُ العَصَبِيُّ مِنْ عَناءِ اليَقَظَةِ، فَيَصْحو الإِنْسانُ وَقَدْ عادَ إِلَيْهِ نَشاطُهُ.
dialogue.tr: wayastarīḥu l-jihāzu l-ʿaṣabiyyu min ʿanāʾi l-yaqaẓati, fayaṣḥū l-ʾinsānu waqad ʿāda ilayhi nashāṭuh.
dialogue.en: The nervous system rests from the toil of wakefulness, and the person wakes up with his energy back.
dialogue.ur: Aasabi nizam jaagne ki mashaqqat se aaram pata hai, aur insan jaagta hai to us ka josh lautaa hota hai.

dialogue.ar: وَإِذا نامَ الإِنْسانُ نَوْماً ثَقيلاً ضَعُفَ تَحَكُّمُهُ في إِرادَتِهِ، وَلَمْ يَشْعُرْ بِما حَوْلَهُ.
dialogue.tr: waʾidhā nāma l-ʾinsānu nawman thaqīlan ḍaʿufa taḥakkumuhu fī irādatih, walam yashʿur bimā ḥawlah.
dialogue.en: If a person sleeps heavily, his control over his will weakens and he does not feel what is around him.
dialogue.ur: Jab insan gehri neend sota hai to us ka apni iraday par qaboo kamzor ho jata hai aur use apne gird ki khabar nahin hoti.

dialogue.ar: وَيُعَدُّ النَّوْمُ المُسْتَغْرِقُ ناقِضاً لِلْوُضوءِ.
dialogue.tr: wayuʿaddu n-nawmu l-mustaghriqu nāqiḍan lilwuḍūʾ.
dialogue.en: Deep sleep is counted as something that breaks wudu.
dialogue.ur: Gehri neend wuzu ko tod deti hai.

dialogue.ar: اللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى الْأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَالَّتِي لَمْ تَمُتْ فِي مَنَامِهَا.
dialogue.tr: Allāh yatawaffaā l-ʾanfusa ḥīna mawtihā wa-llatī lam tamut fī manāmihā.
dialogue.en: Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that have not died, during their sleep.
dialogue.ur: Allah rooh ko un ki maut ke waqt qabz karta hai, aur jo nahin mareen unhein un ki neend mein.

dialogue.ar: وَما إِنْ يَسْتَيْقِظَ المُسْلِمُ حَتّى يَحْمَدَ اللهَ الَّذي أَعادَ إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wamā in yastayqiẓa l-muslimu ḥattā yaḥmada Allāh alladhī aʿāda ilayhi yawmah.
dialogue.en: No sooner does the Muslim wake up than he praises Allah, who gave him back his day.
dialogue.ur: Musalman jaise hi jaagta hai Allah ki hamd karta hai jis ne use us ka din lauta diya.

dialogue.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا.
dialogue.tr: wajaʿalnā nawmakum subātan.
dialogue.en: And We made your sleep a rest.
dialogue.ur: Aur hum ne tumhari neend ko aaram banaya.

dialogue.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا اللَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا.
dialogue.tr: wajaʿalnā l-layla libāsan.
dialogue.en: And We made the night a covering.
dialogue.ur: Aur hum ne raat ko libaas banaya.

dialogue.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا النَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا.
dialogue.tr: wajaʿalnā n-nahāra maʿāshan.
dialogue.en: And We made the day for earning a living.
dialogue.ur: Aur hum ne din ko rozi kamane ka waqt banaya.

dialogue.ar: وَلِذلِكَ يُفَضِّلُ الأَطِبّاءُ النَّوْمَ في اللَّيْلِ، فَهُوَ أَقْرَبُ إِلى طَبيعَةِ الجِسْمِ.
dialogue.tr: walidhlika yufaḍḍilu l-ʾaṭibbāʾu n-nawma fī l-layl, fahuwa aqrabu ilā ṭabīʿati l-jism.
dialogue.en: That is why doctors prefer sleep at night; it is closer to the nature of the body.
dialogue.ur: Isi liye doctor raat ki neend ko behtar samajhte hain, kyunke yeh jism ki fitrat ke zyada qareeb hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنَ الأَخْطاءِ الشّائِعَةِ أَنْ يَسْهَرَ بَعْضُ الشَّبابِ أَمامَ الشّاشاتِ حَتّى الفَجْرِ، فَيَقِلَّ إِنْتاجُهُمْ في النَّهارِ.
dialogue.tr: wamina l-ʾakhṭāʾi sh-shāʾiʿati an yashara baʿḍu sh-shabābi amāma sh-shāshāti ḥattā l-fajr, fayaqilla intājuhum fī n-nahār.
dialogue.en: One common mistake is that some young people stay up in front of screens until dawn, so their output drops during the day.
dialogue.ur: Aam ghalti yeh hai ke kuch naujawan fajr tak screen ke saamne jaagte hain, to din mein un ki karkardagi kam ho jati hai.

dialogue.ar: يَحْتاجُ مُعْظَمُ البالِغينَ إِلى ما بَيْنَ سَبْعِ ساعاتٍ وَتِسْعٍ مِنَ النَّوْمِ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: yaḥtāju muʿẓamu l-bālighīna ilā mā bayna sabʿi sāʿātin watisʿin mina n-nawmi kulla laylatin.
dialogue.en: Most adults need between seven and nine hours of sleep every night.
dialogue.ur: Zyadatar baligh logon ko har raat saat se nau ghantay ki neend chahiye hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا الأَطْفالُ فَهُمْ أَحْوَجُ إِلى ساعاتٍ أَكْثَرَ، لِأَنَّهُمْ يَنْمونَ وَهُمْ نائِمونَ.
dialogue.tr: ammā l-ʾaṭfālu fahum aḥwaju ilā sāʿātin akthar, liʾannahum yanmūna wahum nāʾimūn.
dialogue.en: Children need even more hours, because they grow while they sleep.
dialogue.ur: Bachon ko is se bhi zyada ghantay chahiye, kyunke woh sote hue barhte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَلا يَسْتَغْرِقُ النّاسُ في النَّوْمِ بِالدَّرَجَةِ نَفْسِها؛ فَبَعْضُهُمْ يُصابُ بِالأَرَقِ وَيَتَقَلَّبُ في فِراشِهِ طَويلاً.
dialogue.tr: walā yastaghriqu n-nāsu fī n-nawmi bi-d-darajati nafsihā; fabaʿḍuhum yuṣābu bi-l-ʾaraqi wayataqallabu fī firāshihi ṭaūīlan.
dialogue.en: People do not sink into sleep to the same degree; some suffer from sleeplessness and toss in bed for a long time.
dialogue.ur: Sab log yaksan gehri neend nahin sote; kuch ko be-khwabi ho jati hai aur woh der tak bistar mein karwatein badalte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَنَصيحَتُنا لِنَوْمٍ عَميقٍ: اِبْتَعِدْ عَنِ الضَّجيجِ، وَأَطْفِئِ الأَنْوارَ، وَلا تَشْرَبْ شاياً قَوِيّاً قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ.
dialogue.tr: wanaṣīḥatunā linawmin ʿamīqin: ibtaʿid ʿani ḍ-ḍajīj, waʾaṭfiʾi l-ʾanūār, walā tashrab shāyan qawiyyan qabla n-nawm.
dialogue.en: Our advice for deep sleep: keep away from noise, turn off the lights, and do not drink strong tea before bed.
dialogue.ur: Gehri neend ke liye hamara mashwara: shor se door raho, roshniyan bujha do aur sone se pehle tez chai na piyo.

dialogue.ar: وَاذْهَبْ إِلى فِراشِكَ حينَ يَغْلِبُكَ النُّعاسُ، وَقُمْ في المَوْعِدِ نَفْسِهِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
dialogue.tr: wādhhab ilā firāshika ḥīna yaghlibuka n-nuʿās, waqum fī l-mawʿidi nafsihi kulla yawmin.
dialogue.en: Go to your bed when drowsiness overcomes you, and get up at the same time every day.
dialogue.ur: Jab ounghh ghalib aaye tab bistar par jao aur har roz usi waqt par uthho.

dialogue.ar: نَوْماً هَنيئاً، وَصَباحاً نَشيطاً!
dialogue.tr: nawman hanīʾan, waṣabāḥan nashīṭan!
dialogue.en: Sweet sleep, and an energetic morning!
dialogue.ur: Meethi neend aur taro taza subah!

q.en: According to the text, who needs sleep?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq neend kise chahiye?
q.ar: حَسَبَ النَّصِّ، مَنْ يَحْتاجُ إِلى النَّوْمِ؟

q.en: Which sleep is described as more beneficial for the body?
q.ur: Kaun si neend jism ke liye zyada faida mand batayi gayi?
q.ar: أَيُّ نَوْمٍ يَصِفُهُ النَّصُّ بِأَنَّهُ أَنْفَعُ لِلْجِسْمِ؟

q.en: How many hours do most adults need each night, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq zyadatar baligh logon ko har raat kitne ghantay chahiye?
q.ar: حَسَبَ النَّصِّ، كَمْ ساعَةً يَحْتاجُ أَكْثَرُ البالِغينَ إِلى النَّوْمِ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ؟

q.ur: «الأَرَقُ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What advice does the text give for a deep sleep?
q.ur: Gehri neend ke liye matn kya mashwara deta hai?
q.ar: ما النَّصيحَةُ الَّتي يُقَدِّمُها النَّصُّ لِنَوْمٍ عَميقٍ؟

options: Keep away from noise and turn off the lights

intro.en: Exercises on the text: true or false, matching causes with results, short answers, singular and plural words, and opposite words (antonyms). Learn the plural forms and opposites from the text.
intro.ur: Matn par mashqen: sahi ya ghalat, wajah aur nateeja milana, mukhtasar jawab, wahid jama ke alfaaz aur mutazaad alfaaz. Matn se jama aur mutazaad lafz seekhein.
intro.ar: تَمارينُ عَلى النَّصِّ: صَحيحٌ أَمْ خَطَأٌ، وَمُطابَقَةُ الأَسْبابِ بِالنَّتائِجِ، وَإِجاباتٌ قَصيرَةٌ، وَالمُفْرَدُ وَالجَمْعُ، وَالأَضْدادُ. تَعَلَّمْ جُموعَ الكَلِماتِ وَأَضْدادَها مِنَ النَّصِّ.

dialogue.ar: النَّوْمُ ضَرورَةٌ لِلْإِنْسانِ فَقَطْ.
dialogue.tr: an-nawmu ḍarūratun lilʾinsāni faqaṭ.
dialogue.en: Sleep is a necessity for humans only. (True or false?)
dialogue.ur: Neend sirf insan ki zaroorat hai. (Sahi ya ghalat?)

dialogue.ar: تَبْطُؤُ دَقّاتُ القَلْبِ حينَ يَنامُ الإِنْسانُ.
dialogue.tr: tabṭuʾu daqqātu l-qalbi ḥīna yanāmu l-ʾinsān.
dialogue.en: The heartbeats slow down when a person sleeps. (True or false?)
dialogue.ur: Insan sotay waqt dil ki dhadkanein aahista ho jati hain. (Sahi ya ghalat?)

dialogue.ar: يُفَضِّلُ الأَطِبّاءُ النَّوْمَ في النَّهارِ عَلى النَّوْمِ في اللَّيْلِ.
dialogue.tr: yufaḍḍilu l-ʾaṭibbāʾu n-nawma fī n-nahāri ʿalā n-nawmi fī l-layl.
dialogue.en: Doctors prefer sleeping by day to sleeping at night. (True or false?)
dialogue.ur: Doctor raat ki bajaye din ki neend ko tarjeeh dete hain. (Sahi ya ghalat?)

dialogue.ar: لِماذا يَتَمَنّى بَعْضُ العامِلينَ نَوْماً مُريحاً؟
dialogue.tr: limādhā yatamannā baʿḍu l-ʿāmilīna nawman murīḥan?
dialogue.en: Why do some workers wish for restful sleep?
dialogue.ur: Kuch mulazim aaram deh neend ki tamanna kyun karte hain?

dialogue.ar: ماذا يَحْدُثُ لِعَضَلاتِ الإِنْسانِ حينَ يَنامُ؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā yaḥduthu liʿaḍalāti l-ʾinsāni ḥīna yanām?
dialogue.en: What happens to a person's muscles when he sleeps?
dialogue.ur: Insan jab sota hai to us ke pathon ko kya hota hai?

dialogue.ar: ما الخَطَأُ الشّائِعُ عِنْدَ بَعْضِ الشَّبابِ في النَّوْمِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā l-khaṭaʾu sh-shāʾiʿu ʿinda baʿḍi sh-shabābi fī n-nawm?
dialogue.en: What is the common mistake some young people make about sleep?
dialogue.ur: Kuch naujawanon ki neend ke baare mein aam ghalti kya hai?

dialogue.ar: ماذا يَنْصَحُ الأَطِبّاءُ مَنْ يَشْكو مِنَ الأَرَقِ؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā yanṣaḥu l-ʾaṭibbāʾu man yashkū mina l-ʾaraq?
dialogue.en: What do doctors advise someone who suffers from sleeplessness?
dialogue.ur: Be-khwabi ke shikar shakhs ko doctor kya mashwara dete hain?

vocab.ur: napasand karta hai ≠ pasand karta hai

«مُراهِق» ka matlab:

intro.en: Some Arabic nouns are 'diptotes' (المَمْنوعُ مِنَ الصَّرْف): they never take tanween, and in the genitive they end with a fatha instead of a kasra. In this lesson: feminine names (فاطِمَةُ), foreign names (إِبْراهيمُ), names ending in ـان (عِمْرانَ), verb-pattern names (أَحْمَدُ), compound names (بَعْلَبَكَّ), and names on the pattern فُعَلُ (عُمَرُ).
intro.ur: Arabi ke kuch ism 'mamnoo' minas-sarf' kehlate hain: unpar tanween nahin aata, aur jar ki halat mein kasra ki jagah fatha aata hai. Is sabaq mein: muannas naam (فاطِمَةُ), ajmi naam (إِبْراهيمُ), ـان par khatam hone wale naam (عِمْرانَ), fel ke wazn par naam (أَحْمَدُ), murakkab naam (بَعْلَبَكَّ) aur فُعَلُ ke wazn par naam (عُمَرُ).
intro.ar: بَعْضُ الأَسْماءِ العَرَبِيَّةِ «مَمْنوعَةٌ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ»: لا تَأْخُذُ تَنْوينًا، وَتُجَرُّ بِالفَتْحَةِ بَدَلَ الكَسْرَةِ. في هذا الدَّرْسِ: أَسْماءُ المُؤَنَّثِ (فاطِمَةُ)، وَالأَسْماءُ الأَعْجَمِيَّةُ (إِبْراهيمُ)، وَما يَنْتَهي بِأَلِفٍ وَنونٍ (عِمْرانَ)، وَما عَلى وَزْنِ الفِعْلِ (أَحْمَدُ)، وَالمُرَكَّبُ (بَعْلَبَكَّ)، وَما عَلى وَزْنِ فُعَلَ (عُمَرُ).

dialogue.ar: زَيْنَبُ وَخَديجَةُ مِنْ أُمَّهاتِ المُؤْمِنينَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُنَّ.
dialogue.tr: zaynabu wakhadījatu min ummahāti l-muʾminīna raḍiya Allāh ʿanhunna.
dialogue.en: Zaynab and Khadijah are among the Mothers of the Believers, may Allah be pleased with them.
dialogue.ur: Zainab aur Khadija Ummahat-ul-Momineen mein se hain, Allah un se raazi ho.

dialogue.ar: يَا مَرْيَمُ اقْنُتِي لِرَبِّكِ.
dialogue.tr: yā maryamu qnutī li-rabbiki
dialogue.en: O Maryam, be devoutly obedient to your Lord.
dialogue.ur: Aye Maryam, apne Rab ke liye farmanbardar ban ja.

dialogue.ar: رَجَعَ مُعاوِيَةُ وَأُسامَةُ مِنَ المَدْرَسَةِ.
dialogue.tr: rajaʿa muʿāwiyatu waʾusāmatu mina l-madrasati.
dialogue.en: Muawiyah and Usamah came back from school.
dialogue.ur: Muawiya aur Usama school se wapas aaye.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ كَانَ أُمَّةً قَانِتًا لِّلَّهِ.
dialogue.tr: inna ibrāhīma kāna ummatan qānitan lillāh
dialogue.en: Indeed Ibrahim was a nation (in himself), devoutly obedient to Allah.
dialogue.ur: Be shak Ibrahim ek poori ummat the, Allah ke farmanbardar.

dialogue.ar: بَغْدادُ عاصِمَةُ العِراقِ.
dialogue.tr: baghdādu ʿāṣimatu l-ʿirāq.
dialogue.en: Baghdad is the capital of Iraq.
dialogue.ur: Baghdad Iraq ka daar-ul-hukumat hai.

dialogue.ar: شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي أُنزِلَ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ.
dialogue.tr: shahru ramaḍāna lladhī unzila fīhi l-qur'ān
dialogue.en: The month of Ramadan in which the Quran was revealed.
dialogue.ur: Ramazan ka mahina jis mein Quran nazil kiya gaya.

dialogue.ar: وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَانَ الَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا.
dialogue.tr: wa maryama ibnata ʿimrāna llatī aḥṣanat farjahā
dialogue.en: And Maryam, daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity.
dialogue.ur: Aur Maryam, Imran ki beti, jis ne apni pakdamani ki hifazat ki.

dialogue.ar: سَلَّمْتُ عَلى أَحْمَدَ وَسُلَيْمانَ في المَسْجِدِ.
dialogue.tr: sallamtu ʿalā aḥmada wasulaymāna fī l-masjid.
dialogue.en: I greeted Ahmad and Sulayman in the mosque.
dialogue.ur: Maine masjid mein Ahmad aur Sulaiman ko salam kiya.

dialogue.ar: سافَرَ عُمَرُ إِلى إِسْطَنْبولَ وَرَجَعَ مِنْ دِمَشْقَ.
dialogue.tr: sāfara ʿumaru ilā isṭanbūla warajaʿa min dimashq.
dialogue.en: Umar travelled to Istanbul and came back from Damascus.
dialogue.ur: Umar Istanbul gaya aur Damishq se wapas aaya.

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ هَدِيَّةٌ مِنْ سَلْمانَ إِلى إِبْراهيمَ.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi hadiyyatun min salmāna ilā ibrāhīm.
dialogue.en: This is a gift from Salman to Ibrahim.
dialogue.ur: Yeh Salman ki taraf se Ibrahim ke liye tohfa hai.

q.ur: Kya mamnoo' minas-sarf par tanween aata hai?
q.ar: هَلْ يَأْخُذُ المَمْنوعُ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ تَنْوينًا؟

q.en: Which of these is a feminine name?

intro.en: Listen to two parts and answer: true or false, choose the right answer, and match causes with results. The topic is sleep, dreams and what happens when a person does not sleep. Play the audio on the slides.
intro.ur: Do hissay sunein aur jawab dein: sahi ya ghalat, durust jawab chunein, aur wajah aur nateeja milayen. Mauzu neend, khwab aur neend na lene ke asraat hain. Slides par maujood audio chalayen.
intro.ar: تَسْتَمِعُ إِلى جُزْأَيْنِ ثُمَّ تُجيبُ: صَحيحٌ أَمْ خَطَأٌ، وَاخْتِيارُ الإِجابَةِ، وَمُطابَقَةُ الأَسْبابِ بِالنَّتائِجِ. المَوْضوعُ هُوَ النَّوْمُ وَالأَحْلامُ وَما يَحْدُثُ لِمَنْ لا يَنامُ. شَغِّلِ الصَّوْتَ عَلى الشَّرائِحِ.

dialogue.ar: يُحِسُّ النّائِمُ بِكُلِّ ما يَدورُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِ في أَثْناءِ نَوْمِهِ.
dialogue.tr: yuḥissu n-nāʾimu bikulli mā yadūru min ḥawlihi fī athnāʾi nawmih.
dialogue.en: The sleeper feels everything going on around him during his sleep.
dialogue.ur: Sone wala neend ke dauran apne gird ki har cheez mehsoos karta hai.

dialogue.ar: يَشْعُرُ الإِنْسانُ بِالراحَةِ في جِسْمِهِ وَعَقْلِهِ بَعْدَ نَوْمٍ كافٍ.
dialogue.tr: yashʿuru l-ʾinsānu bi-r-rāḥati fī jismihi waʿaqlihi baʿda nawmin kāfin.
dialogue.en: A person feels rest in his body and mind after enough sleep.
dialogue.ur: Kaafi neend ke baad insan apne jism aur zehn mein sukoon mehsoos karta hai.

dialogue.ar: تَتَوَقَّفُ حَرَكَةُ الجِسْمِ تَماماً طَوالَ اللَّيْلِ.
dialogue.tr: tatawaqqafu ḥarakatu l-jismi tamāman ṭaūāla l-layl.
dialogue.en: The body's movement stops completely all night.
dialogue.ur: Jism ki harkat poori raat bilkul ruk jati hai.

dialogue.ar: مَنْ يَصْحو أَيّاماً مُتَتابِعَةً يَتَأَذّى جِسْمُهُ وَعَقْلُهُ.
dialogue.tr: man yaṣḥū ayyāman mutatābiʿatan yataʾadhdhā jismuhu waʿaqluh.
dialogue.en: Whoever stays awake for days in a row, his body and mind get hurt.
dialogue.ur: Jo musalsal kai din jaagta rahe us ka jism aur zehn mutasir hota hai.

dialogue.ar: كَثيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ يَتَذَكَّرونَ أَحْلاماً سارَّةً بَعْدَ الاسْتِيقاظِ.
dialogue.tr: kathīrun mina n-nāsi yatadhakkarūna aḥlāman sārratan baʿda l-āstīqāẓ.
dialogue.en: Many people remember pleasant dreams after waking up.
dialogue.ur: Bohat se log jaagne ke baad khushgawar khwab yaad rakhte hain.

dialogue.ar: قِلَّةُ النَّوْمِ تُؤْذي التَّفْكيرَ وَتُضْعِفُ التَّرْكيزَ.
dialogue.tr: qillatu n-nawmi tuʾdhī t-tafkīra watuḍʿifu t-tarkīz.
dialogue.en: Little sleep harms thinking and weakens concentration.
dialogue.ur: Kam neend sochne ko nuqsan deti hai aur tawajjoh kamzor karti hai.

dialogue.ar: قَدْ يَكونُ بَعْضُ الأَحْلامِ قِصَّةً خَيالِيَّةً طَويلَةً.
dialogue.tr: qad yakūnu baʿḍu l-ʾaḥlāmi qiṣṣatan khaīāliyyatan ṭaūīlatan.
dialogue.en: Some dreams may be a long imaginary story.
dialogue.ur: Kuch khwab ek lambi khayali kahani ki tarah hote hain.

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى شَيْءٍ لَطيفٍ يُدْخِلُ السُّرورَ؟

intro.en: Practise speaking with a partner (questions about sleep), say the right phrase in daily situations, and write a short essay on 'Sleep and insomnia'. Learn the useful question words and phrases.
intro.ur: Saathi ke saath bolne ki mashq (neend ke sawalat), rozmarra mauqon par sahi jumla kehna, aur 'Neend aur be khwabi' par mukhtasar mazmoon likhna. Kaam ke sawaliya alfaaz aur jumlay seekhein.
intro.ar: تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى الحَديثِ مَعَ زَميلٍ (أَسْئِلَةٌ عَنِ النَّوْمِ)، وَعَلى قَوْلِ العِبارَةِ المُناسِبَةِ في مَواقِفَ يَوْمِيَّةٍ، ثُمَّ تَكْتُبُ مَوْضوعًا قَصيرًا عَنِ «النَّوْمِ وَالأَرَقِ». تَعَلَّمْ أَدَواتِ السُّؤالِ وَالعِباراتِ المُفيدَةَ.

dialogue.ar: كَمْ مِنَ الوَقْتِ تَقْضيهِ نائِماً في اللَّيْلِ عادَةً؟
dialogue.tr: kam mina l-waqti taqḍīhi nāʾiman fī l-layli ʿādatan?
dialogue.en: How much time do you usually spend asleep at night?
dialogue.ur: Aap aam taur par raat ko kitna waqt sote guzarte hain?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَنامُ مُتَأَخِّراً في يَوْمِ العُطْلَةِ؟ لِماذا؟
dialogue.tr: hal tanāmu mutaʾakhkhiran fī yawmi l-ʿuṭlati? limādhā?
dialogue.en: Do you sleep late on a day off? Why?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap chhutti ke din der se sote hain? Kyun?

dialogue.ar: مَتى تَسْهَرُ طَويلاً؟ وَماذا تَفْعَلُ؟
dialogue.tr: matā tasharu ṭaūīlan? wa mādhā tafʿal?
dialogue.en: When do you stay up for a long time? And what do you do?
dialogue.ur: Aap kab der tak jaagte hain? Aur kya karte hain?

dialogue.ar: ما رَأْيُكَ في الأَكْلِ الكَثيرِ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā raʾyuka fī l-ʾakli l-kathīri qabla n-nawm?
dialogue.en: What is your opinion of eating a lot before sleep?
dialogue.ur: Sone se pehle bohat khane ke baare mein aap ki kya raaye hai?

dialogue.ar: ما الأَشْياءُ المُزْعِجَةُ الَّتي تَمْنَعُكَ مِنَ النَّوْمِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā l-ʾashīāʾu l-muzʿijatu allatī tamnaʿuka mina n-nawm?
dialogue.en: What annoying things keep you from sleeping?
dialogue.ur: Woh kaun si pareshan karne wali cheezein hain jo aap ko sone se rokti hain?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَعْرِفُ شَيْئاً مِنْ آدابِ النَّوْمِ وَأَذْكارِهِ؟
dialogue.tr: hal taʿrifu shayʾan min ʾādābi n-nawmi waʾadhkārih?
dialogue.en: Do you know anything of the manners and supplications of sleep?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap neend ke adaab aur azkaar mein se kuch jante hain?

dialogue.ar: ما الفَرْقُ في النَّشاطِ بَيْنَ مَنْ يَنامُ باكِراً وَمَنْ يَسْهَرُ؟
dialogue.tr: mā l-farqu fī n-nashāṭi bayna man yanāmu bākiran waman yashar?
dialogue.en: What is the difference in energy between someone who sleeps early and someone who stays up?
dialogue.ur: Jaldi sone wale aur jaagne wale ke josh mein kya farq hota hai?

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ تَشْعُرُ في اليَوْمِ التّالي إِذا حُرِمْتَ مِنَ النَّوْمِ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa tashʿuru fī l-yawmi t-tālī idhā ḥurimta mina n-nawm?
dialogue.en: How do you feel the next day if you are deprived of sleep?
dialogue.ur: Agar aap neend se mehroom rahen to agle din kaisa mehsoos karte hain?

q.en: How do you ask 'How many hours do you sleep?'
q.ur: 'Aap kitne ghante sote hain?' kaise poochte hain?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ عَنْ عَدَدِ ساعاتِ النَّوْمِ؟

q.ur: «مَتى» kis ke baare mein poochne ke liye hai?

title.ar: الإِمْلاء: كِتابَةُ الهَمْزَةِ في أَوَّلِ الكَلِمَةِ
title.en: Dictation: Hamza at the start of a word (Lesson 48)
title.ur: Imla: Lafz ke shuru mein hamza likhna (Sabaq 48)

intro.en: There are two kinds of hamza at the start of a word. Hamzat al-wasl (وَصْل) is dropped in the middle of speech and written as a plain alif: اسْمي، اجْلِسْ. Hamzat al-qat' (قَطْع) is always pronounced and has a mark: أ with fatha or damma, إ with kasra: أَكَلَ، أُذُن، إِبِل.
intro.ur: Lafz ke shuru mein hamza ki do qismein hain. Hamza-e-wasl darmiyan-e-kalam mein gir jata hai aur sirf alif likha jata hai: اسْمي، اجْلِسْ. Hamza-e-qat' hamesha parha jata hai aur us par nishan hota hai: fatha ya damma ke saath أ, kasra ke saath إ: أَكَلَ، أُذُن، إِبِل.
intro.ar: لِلْهَمْزَةِ في أَوَّلِ الكَلِمَةِ نَوْعانِ: هَمْزَةُ وَصْلٍ تَسْقُطُ في وَسَطِ الكَلامِ وَتُكْتَبُ أَلِفًا بِلا عَلامَةٍ: اسْمي، اجْلِسْ. وَهَمْزَةُ قَطْعٍ تُنْطَقُ دائِمًا وَلَها عَلامَةٌ: أ بِالفَتْحَةِ أَوِ الضَّمَّةِ، وَإ بِالكَسْرَةِ: أَكَلَ، أُذُن، إِبِل.

dialogue.ar: اسْمُ أُخْتي سارَةُ.
dialogue.tr: smu ukhtī sāratu.
dialogue.en: My sister's name is Sarah. (wasl: plain alif)
dialogue.ur: Meri behan ka naam Sara hai. (wasl: saada alif)

dialogue.ar: اِفْتَحِ البابَ وَاخْرُجْ.
dialogue.tr: iftaḥi l-bāba wākhruj.
dialogue.en: Open the door and go out. (wasl: plain alif)
dialogue.ur: Darwaza kholo aur bahar niklo. (wasl: saada alif)

dialogue.ar: اِبْنُ جاري طالِبٌ.
dialogue.tr: ibnu jārī ṭālibun.
dialogue.en: My neighbour's son is a student. (wasl: plain alif)
dialogue.ur: Mere padosi ka beta talib-e-ilm hai. (wasl: saada alif)

dialogue.ar: اُكْتُبْ دَرْسَكَ.
dialogue.tr: uktub darsak.
dialogue.en: Write your lesson. (wasl: plain alif with damma)
dialogue.ur: Apna sabaq likho. (wasl: damma wala saada alif)

dialogue.ar: أَخَذَ.
dialogue.tr: akhadh.
dialogue.en: He took. (qat': alif with fatha)
dialogue.ur: Us ne liya. (qat: fatha wala alif)

dialogue.ar: أُسْرَة.
dialogue.tr: usraa.
dialogue.en: A family. (qat': alif with damma)
dialogue.ur: Ek khandan. (qat: damma wala alif)

dialogue.ar: إِصْبَع.
dialogue.tr: iṣbaʿ.
dialogue.en: A finger. (qat': alif with kasra)
dialogue.ur: Ek ungli. (qat: kasra wala alif)

dialogue.ar: أَنا وَأَخي.
dialogue.tr: anā waʾakhī.
dialogue.en: I and my brother. (qat': always pronounced)
dialogue.ur: Main aur mera bhai. (qat: hamesha parhi jati hai)

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz hamza-e-wasl se shuru hota hai?

q.en: Which word has hamza with kasra below the alif?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein alif ke neeche kasra wala hamza hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ فيها هَمْزَةٌ تَحْتَ الأَلِفِ بِكَسْرَةٍ؟

q.ur: «أُذُن» shuru hota hai:

q.ur: Jumle ke darmiyan mein hamza-e-wasl:

intro.en: More diptotes: the pattern أَفْعَلُ (أَحْسَنُ), feminine alif endings (ذِكْرى، صَفْراءُ), the pattern فُعَلُ (أُخَرُ), numbers like مَثْنى, and the broken plurals of the 'mafā'il' type (مَساجِدُ، مَصابيحُ). Remember: no tanween, and fatha for jarr. Finally, match ideas with the paragraphs of the reading text.
intro.ur: Mazeed mamnoo' minas-sarf: أَفْعَلُ ka wazn (أَحْسَنُ), muannas alif par khatam hone wale (ذِكْرى، صَفْراءُ), فُعَلُ ka wazn (أُخَرُ), مَثْنى jaise adad, aur 'mafaa'il' wazn ki jama-e-taksir (مَساجِدُ، مَصابيحُ). Yaad rakhein: tanween nahin, aur jar mein fatha. Aakhir mein khayalat ko matn ke paragraphon se milayen.
intro.ar: مَزيدٌ مِنَ المَمْنوعِ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ: وَزْنُ أَفْعَلَ (أَحْسَنُ)، وَأَلِفُ التَّأْنيثِ (ذِكْرى، صَفْراءُ)، وَوَزْنُ فُعَلَ (أُخَرُ)، وَالأَعْدادُ مِثْلُ مَثْنى، وَجُموعُ التَّكْسيرِ عَلى وَزْنِ مَفاعِلَ (مَساجِدُ، مَصابيحُ). تَذَكَّرْ: لا تَنْوينَ، وَالجَرُّ بِالفَتْحَةِ. ثُمَّ طابِقِ الأَفْكارَ بِفِقَراتِ النَّصِّ.

dialogue.ar: وَلَمَّا رَجَعَ مُوسَىٰ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ غَضْبَانَ أَسِفًا.
dialogue.tr: wa lammā rajaʿa mūsā ilā qawmihi ghaḍbāna asifā
dialogue.en: And when Musa returned to his people, angry and grieved.
dialogue.ur: Aur jab Musa apni qaum ki taraf ghussay aur ranj ke saath lautay.

dialogue.ar: وَإِذَا حُيِّيتُم بِتَحِيَّةٍ فَحَيُّوا بِأَحْسَنَ مِنْهَا أَوْ رُدُّوهَا.
dialogue.tr: wa idhā ḥuyyītum bi-taḥiyyatin fa-ḥayyū bi-aḥsana minhā aw ruddūhā
dialogue.en: And when you are greeted with a greeting, greet with better than it, or return it.
dialogue.ur: Aur jab tumhein salam kiya jaye to us se behtar jawab do ya wohi lauta do.

dialogue.ar: وَالْفِتْنَةُ أَكْبَرُ مِنَ الْقَتْلِ.
dialogue.tr: wal-fitnatu akbaru mina l-qatl
dialogue.en: And persecution is worse than killing.
dialogue.ur: Aur fitna qatl se bhi bada hai.

dialogue.ar: أُولِي أَجْنِحَةٍ مَّثْنَىٰ وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ.
dialogue.tr: ūlī ajniḥatin mathnā wa thulātha wa rubāʿ
dialogue.en: Having wings, two, three and four.
dialogue.ur: Jin ke par hain, do do, teen teen aur chaar chaar.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ.
dialogue.tr: inna fī dhālika la-dhikrā li-ulī l-albāb
dialogue.en: Indeed in that is a reminder for people of understanding.
dialogue.ur: Be shak is mein aqal walon ke liye nasihat hai.

dialogue.ar: لَّهُدِّمَتْ صَوَامِعُ وَبِيَعٌ وَصَلَوَاتٌ وَمَسَاجِدُ.
dialogue.tr: la-huddimat ṣawāmiʿu wa biyaʿun wa ṣalawātun wa masājid
dialogue.en: Monasteries, churches, synagogues and mosques would have been demolished.
dialogue.ur: Khanqahein, girjay, ibadatgahein aur masjidein dhaa di jati.

dialogue.ar: وَزَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَحِفْظًا.
dialogue.tr: wa zayyannā s-samā'a d-dunyā bi-maṣābīḥa wa ḥifẓā
dialogue.en: And We adorned the lowest heaven with lamps and as protection.
dialogue.ur: Aur humne qareeb ke aasman ko chiraghon se saja diya aur hifazat ke liye.

dialogue.ar: بَنى الأَهالي مَساجِدَ جَديدَةً في القَرْيَةِ.
dialogue.tr: banā l-ʾahālī masājida jadīdatan fī l-qaryati.
dialogue.en: The people built new mosques in the village.
dialogue.ur: Logon ne gaon mein nayi masjidein banayin.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ أَيّامِكُمْ يَوْمَ الجُمُعَةِ.
dialogue.tr: inna min afḍali ayyāmikum yawma l-jumuʿah
dialogue.en: Indeed among the best of your days is the day of Jumuah.
dialogue.ur: Be shak tumhare behtareen dinon mein se Jumua ka din hai.

dialogue.ar: يَجِدُ الجِسْمُ في النَّوْمِ راحَةً، وَالسَّهَرُ الطَّويلُ يُتْعِبُهُ. (الفِقْرَةُ ١)
dialogue.tr: yajidu l-jismu fī n-nawmi rāḥatan, wa-s-saharu ṭ-ṭaūīlu yutʿibuh. al-fiqratu ١
dialogue.en: The body finds rest in sleep, and long staying up tires it. (paragraph 1)
dialogue.ur: Jism ko neend mein aaram milta hai aur lamba jaagna use thaka deta hai. (paragraph 1)

dialogue.ar: يُفَضِّلُ الأَطِبّاءُ النَّوْمَ المُبَكِّرَ عَلى السَّهَرِ. (الفِقْرَةُ ٤)
dialogue.tr: yufaḍḍilu l-ʾaṭibbāʾu n-nawma l-mubakkira ʿalā s-sahar. al-fiqratu ٤
dialogue.en: Doctors prefer early sleep to staying up. (paragraph 4)
dialogue.ur: Doctor jaldi sone ko jaagne par tarjeeh dete hain. (paragraph 4)

vocab.ur: do do, teen teen, chaar chaar

q.en: What is the sign of jarr for a diptote?
q.ur: Mamnoo' minas-sarf ke jar ki alamat kya hai?
q.ar: ما عَلامَةُ الجَرِّ في الاِسْمِ المَمْنوعِ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ؟

q.en: «مَساجِدُ» is a diptote because it is:
q.ur: «مَساجِدُ» mamnoo' minas-sarf is liye hai ke woh:

options: a broken plural of the 'mafā'il' type
options_ar: لِأَنَّها جَمْعُ تَكْسيرٍ عَلى وَزْنِ مَفاعِلَ

q.en: Which of these is a diptote?
q.ur: In mein se kaun sa mamnoo' minas-sarf hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ هذِهِ الكَلِماتِ مَمْنوعَةٌ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ؟

q.en: «أَحْمَدُ» is a diptote because it is:
q.ur: «أَحْمَدُ» mamnoo' minas-sarf is liye hai ke woh:

options: a name on the verb pattern
